tools.name: datafair_list_account_datasets
tools.description: List the datasets owned by the active account (its department included), with optional text search. Without q it lists all of them, page by page (count is the total): prefer that for an inventory, since a keyword can miss a dataset worded differently. Returns id, title, status, row count, and last update.

q.description: French keywords for full-text search (simple terms, not sentences). Examples: "élus", "DPE", "entreprises"

size.description: Taille de la page. La somme de la taille et du décalage (page - 1) × taille ne peut pas dépasser 10000.

response_format.description: concise: id, slug, title, summary, count, status, updatedAt, page. detailed: every field.

tools.name: datafair_create_dataset_from_file
tools.description: Create a dataset in the active account from a data file: CSV, TSV, XLSX, ODS, GeoJSON, a zipped shapefile… Its type is read from the extension of the file name. The title defaults to the file name. The dataset is analysed and indexed in the background, from seconds to minutes: its rows can be searched once its status is finalized (datafair_list_account_datasets shows it).

file.description:
Le fichier de données. Son type est déduit de l'extension de son nom (.csv, .tsv, .xlsx, .ods, .geojson, .zip d'un shapefile…). Le champ peut aussi s'appeler `dataset`.

URL of the file to send, from the file store this server is configured for: the server downloads it and names it after the last path segment, extension included.

tools.name: datafair_list_datasets
tools.description: List the datasets published on the portal you are called from, with optional text search. Returns id, title, row count, and last update. Only available from a portal, not from the back-office.

q.description: French keywords for full-text search (simple terms, not sentences). Examples: "élus", "DPE", "entreprises"

size.description: Taille de la page. La somme de la taille et du décalage (page - 1) × taille ne peut pas dépasser 10000.

response_format.description: concise: id, slug, title, summary, count, updatedAt, page. detailed: every field.

tools.name: datafair_describe_dataset
tools.description: Get detailed metadata and column schema for a dataset: title, description, license, topics, row count, geo/temporal coverage and every column with its type, concept and enum values. Call datafair_search_data with size=3 afterwards to see sample rows.

datasetId.description: The exact dataset ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_datasets (or, on a portal, datafair_list_datasets) results. Do not use the title or slug.

response_format.description: concise: id, slug, title, summary, description, page, count, keywords, origin, license, topics, spatial, temporal, frequency, bbox, timePeriod, schema. detailed: every field.

tools.name: datafair_replace_dataset_file
tools.description: Replace the data file of a file dataset with a new file; all its rows are replaced, its metadata, permissions and publications are kept. If the new file removes or changes the type of a column, the update waits as a draft for a person to validate it in the back-office; otherwise it is applied once indexed.

datasetId.description: The exact dataset ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_datasets (or, on a portal, datafair_list_datasets) results. Do not use the title or slug.

file.description:
Le fichier de données.

URL of the file to send, from the file store this server is configured for: the server downloads it and names it after the last path segment, extension included.

tools.name: datafair_delete_dataset
tools.description: Delete a dataset permanently, with its data. The datasets and applications attached to it (partOf) are deleted too. Irreversible.

datasetId.description: The exact dataset ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_datasets (or, on a portal, datafair_list_datasets) results. Do not use the title or slug.

tools.name: datafair_update_dataset
tools.description: Update the metadata or configuration of a dataset: title, description, keywords, license, topics, schema… Send only the fields to change. Array and object fields (topics, keywords, attachments, schema, configuration…) replace the current value entirely: read it first with datafair_describe_dataset and send the complete new value. Publishing on portals, publications to remote catalogs, the read API key, master-data exposure and attaching to a parent (partOf) are done with datafair_publish_dataset.

datasetId.description: The exact dataset ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_datasets (or, on a portal, datafair_list_datasets) results. Do not use the title or slug.

dataset.description: Restrict to the applications using these datasets (ids from datafair_list_account_datasets).

tools.name: datafair_describe_application
tools.description: Get the metadata and configuration of an application: title, description, base application, the datasets its configuration uses, publication status.

applicationId.description: The exact application ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_applications results.

tools.name: datafair_delete_application
tools.description: Delete an application permanently. The datasets and applications attached to it (partOf) are deleted too. Irreversible.

applicationId.description: The exact application ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_applications results.

tools.name: datafair_update_application
tools.description: Update the metadata or configuration of an application: title, description, topics, configuration… Send only the fields to change. Array and object fields (topics, keywords, attachments, schema, configuration…) replace the current value entirely: read it first with datafair_describe_application and send the complete new value. Publishing on portals, publications to remote catalogs and attaching to a parent (partOf) are done with datafair_publish_application. Do not change configuration.datasets[].applicationKeyPermissions unless explicitly asked: it decides what anyone holding the application key can do on that dataset; send it back as you read it.

applicationId.description: The exact application ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_applications results.

slug.description: Identifier of the application, usually a slug for URL readability (unique inside the tenant)

anyOf.description: URL d'une image, illustration du jeu de données

anyOf.title: App config

key.description: Not the id of the dataset, but a key inside this configuration object to define the role of the dataset in this context.

applicationKeyPermissions.description: The permissions that should be applied to users accessing this dataset through a protecte application key of this application

items.description: API operation that can be used
API permission classes that can be used

url.description: The URL the base application is located at (replaced by baseApp.url)

anyOf.description: The URL the base application for the draft configuration is located at (replaced by baseAppDraft.url)
References to all sites the application would be exposed in if validated by an admin.

Il est possible de consulter plus facilement la liste des icônes disponibles sur ce site .
Commencez à taper pour rechercher dans la collection complète d'icônes. Seuls quelques icônes sont chargées initialement pour de meilleures performances.

Start typing to search through the complete collection of icons. Only a few icons are loaded initially for better performance.

name.description: Name of the file that was used to create or update this attachment

size.description: Size of the file on disk

updatedAt.description: Date of the last update for this attachment

tools.description: Change where an application is exposed: the portals it is published on (publicationSites), its publications to remote catalogs, and its parent resource (partOf, which replaces its permissions with those of the parent). Send only the fields to change.

applicationId.description: The exact application ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_applications results.

anyOf.description: References to all the catalogs the application metadata is published too

catalog.description: L'identifiant du catalogue de destination de cette publication.

status.description: Statut indiquant clairement si la publication a réussi. Si "published", la propriété targetUrl doit être renseignée. Si "error", la propriété error doit être renseignée.

publishedAt.description: Date de la dernière mise à jour de cette publication.

result.description: Résultat de la publication. La structure de cet objet est libre et dépend du type de catalogue.

tools.name: datafair_search_data
tools.description: Retrieve dataset rows matching filters and/or full-text search. Do NOT use it to compute statistics — use datafair_aggregate_data or datafair_calculate_metric. Paginate with the "after" value returned as next.

datasetId.description: The exact dataset ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_datasets (or, on a portal, datafair_list_datasets) results. Do not use the title or slug.

after.description:
Pagination en profondeur : la valeur à passer est celle du paramètre `after` de l'URL **next** du résultat précédent.

*Automatiquement renseigné par la propriété **next** du résultat de la requête précédente.*

size.description: Le nombre de résultats à retourner (taille de la pagination).

sort.description: Array of column keys to sort by, one per element. Prefix a key with - for descending.

select.description: Column keys to include in the response, as an array. Use column keys from datafair_describe_dataset. If omitted, all columns are returned.

query.description: Full-text search across all columns. Prefer filters for structured criteria.

patternPropertiesLayout.help:
Filtres structurés sur colonne.

Le nom est constitué de la clé de la colonne concaténée avec un suffixe par type de filtre (par exemple `ma_colonne_eq`, `ma_colonne_in`, etc.).

Les types de filtres disponibles peuvent varier par colonne.

  - `_eq` : égal à une valeur
  - `_neq` : différent d'une valeur
  - `_in` : appartient à une liste de valeurs (séparées par des virgules)
  - `_nin` : n'appartient pas à une liste de valeurs (séparées par des virgules)
  - `_gt` : strictement supérieur à une valeur
  - `_gte` : supérieur ou égal à une valeur
  - `_lt` : strictement inférieur à une valeur
  - `_lte` : inférieur ou égal à une valeur
  - `_starts` : commence par une série de caractères
  - `_contains` : contient une série de caractères
  - `_search` : effectue une recherche textuelle simple
  - `_exists` : la colonne contient une valeur
  - `_nexists` : la colonne ne contient pas une valeur

filters.description: Column filters as key-value pairs: column_key + suffix, all values strings. Example: { "ville_eq": "Paris", "age_lte": "30", "nom_search": "Jean" }. Suffixes: _eq, _neq, _in, _nin, _gt, _gte, _lt, _lte, _starts, _exists, _nexists, _search (free-text word search, default choice for text), _contains (only when enabled). If a suffix is rejected the 400 error lists what the column supports — read it and adapt. Never prefix with _c_.

bbox.description: Bounding box "lonMin,latMin,lonMax,latMax" (lon before lat), e.g. "-2.5,43,3,47". Geolocalized datasets only.

geoDistance.description: Proximity filter "lon,lat,distance" (lon first), e.g. "2.35,48.85,10km"; distance "0" = point-in-polygon. Geolocalized datasets only.

dateMatch.description: Date "YYYY-MM-DD" (single day) or "YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD" (range), e.g. "2023-11-21". Temporal datasets only.

tools.name: datafair_export_data
tools.description: Export the dataset rows matching filters and/or full-text search to a CSV file, at most 10,000 rows, in the order of sort. Returns a link to the file, not its rows: use it to hand data to another tool or a script, and datafair_search_data to read rows yourself.

datasetId.description: The exact dataset ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_datasets (or, on a portal, datafair_list_datasets) results. Do not use the title or slug.

size.description: Le nombre de résultats à retourner (taille de la pagination).

sort.description: Array of column keys to sort by, one per element. Prefix a key with - for descending.

select.description: Column keys to include in the response, as an array. Use column keys from datafair_describe_dataset. If omitted, all columns are returned.

query.description: Full-text search across all columns. Prefer filters for structured criteria.

size.description: Le nombre de résultats à retourner (taille de la pagination).

tools.name: datafair_aggregate_data
tools.description: Aggregate dataset rows by 1-3 columns with an optional metric (avg, sum, min, max, value_count, cardinality). Defaults to counting rows per group. For a single global metric without grouping, use datafair_calculate_metric.

datasetId.description: The exact dataset ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_datasets (or, on a portal, datafair_list_datasets) results. Do not use the title or slug.

groupByColumns.description: Columns to GROUP BY (like SQL GROUP BY), 1 to 3 keys from datafair_describe_dataset. NOT the column to compute the metric on.

metric.description: Metric computed ON EACH GROUP. Omit to count rows per group.

metricColumn.description: The column to compute the metric on, for the average or sum of that column. Requires metric.

sort.description: Array with one sort key per aggregation level: "count"/"-count" (group size), "key"/"-key" (group value), "metric"/"-metric" (metric value). Example: ["-count"].

q.description:
Colonne de recherche simple. Ce paramètre peut être utilisé pour exposer une fonctionnalité de recherche textuelle riche aux utilisateurs sans risque de créer des erreurs de syntaxe.

  Exemple : `"open data" | "open source"`

  Pour plus d'information voir la documentation [ElasticSearch](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/query-dsl-simple-query-string-query.html) correspondante.

datasetId.description: The exact dataset ID from the "id" field in datafair_list_account_datasets (or, on a portal, datafair_list_datasets) results. Do not use the title or slug.

metric.description: avg, sum, min, max (numbers); min, max, cardinality, value_count (strings); stats returns count/min/max/avg/sum; percentiles returns a distribution.

fieldKey.description: The column key to calculate the metric on (use keys from datafair_describe_dataset)

percents.description: Comma-separated percentages for the percentiles metric (default "1,5,25,50,75,95,99").
